title: 大学 · 语法专题 8 讲

items.title: 完成进行时的语用价值
items.ruleText:
**have been doing** 同时强调“持续”与“未完成”，常用于说明**过程本身**而非结果。
学术写作中用于描述一段时间以来学界的持续关注。

examples.en: Researchers have been debating this issue for two decades.
examples.cn: 研究者就这一议题争论了二十年。

examples.en: The team had been collecting data before the funding ended.
examples.cn: 资金结束前团队一直在收集数据。

exercises.stem: Scholars ______ this phenomenon since the 1990s.
exercises.explanation: since + 时间点，强调持续过程，用现在完成进行时。

exercises.stem: By 2020 the group ______ the survey for five years.
exercises.explanation: By 2020 是过去时间基准，用过去完成进行时。

exercises.stem: 判断：完成进行时既可强调动作持续，也可暗示动作可能尚未结束。
exercises.explanation: 这正是它与完成时的核心区别。

items.title: 名词性从句总览
items.ruleText:
名词性从句包括**主语从句、宾语从句、表语从句、同位语从句**。
引导词 that 在同位语从句中不可省略，在宾语从句中常可省略。
主语从句冗长时常用 **It is … that …** 后置。

examples.en: It is widely accepted that early feedback improves learning.
examples.cn: 人们普遍认为及时反馈有助于学习。

examples.en: The fact that she declined surprised everyone.
examples.cn: 她拒绝这一事实让所有人吃惊。

exercises.stem: ______ he will accept the post remains unclear.
exercises.explanation: 主语从句表示“是否”时只能用 whether，不能用 if。

exercises.stem: The idea ______ money guarantees happiness is questionable.
exercises.explanation: 同位语从句解释 idea 的内容，用 that 引导且不作成分。

exercises.stem: 判断：同位语从句中的 that 可以像宾语从句一样省略。
exercises.explanation: 同位语从句的 that 不可省略。

items.title: 倒装结构
items.ruleText:
否定副词（never / seldom / hardly / not only）置于句首时需**部分倒装**。
only + 状语置于句首同样倒装。
倒装的作用是**强调**并调整信息重心。

examples.en: Never have I seen such a clear explanation.
examples.cn: 我从未见过如此清晰的解释。

examples.en: Only after the trial did the pattern become obvious.
examples.cn: 直到试验之后规律才变得明显。

exercises.stem: Not until the deadline ______ the seriousness of the task.
exercises.explanation: Not until 置于句首，主句部分倒装。

exercises.stem: Seldom ______ such a well-organised report.
exercises.explanation: Seldom 为否定副词，句首触发部分倒装。

exercises.stem: 判断：Not only 位于句首时，只需前半句倒装，后半句保持正常语序。
exercises.explanation: Not only did he …, but he also … 是标准形式。

items.title: 强调句 It is … that …
items.ruleText:
结构 **It is / was + 被强调成分 + that / who + 其余部分**。
可强调主语、宾语、状语，但**不能强调谓语动词**。
判断方法：去掉 It is … that 后句子依然完整。

examples.en: It was in 2015 that the policy took effect.
examples.cn: 正是在 2015 年该政策开始生效。

examples.en: It is the method, not the tool, that matters.
examples.cn: 重要的是方法，而不是工具。

exercises.stem: It was her attitude ______ impressed the interviewers most.
exercises.explanation: 强调句固定用 that（强调人时可用 who）。

exercises.stem: 选出属于强调句的一项：
exercises.explanation: 去掉 It was … that 后 “She handed in the form yesterday.” 依然成立，故为强调句。

options.text: It is obvious that he is tired.
It was yesterday that she handed in the form.

exercises.stem: 判断：强调句可以用来强调句中的谓语动词。
exercises.explanation: 强调谓语需借助 do / does / did，而非 It is … that 结构。

items.title: 独立主格结构
items.ruleText:
**名词 / 代词 + 分词、形容词、介词短语**构成独立主格，作状语，
其逻辑主语与主句主语**不一致**，书面语中用于压缩信息。

examples.en: All things considered, the plan is workable.
The experiment finished, the team wrote up the results.
examples.cn: 实验结束后，团队撰写了结果。

exercises.stem: ______ , we set off before dawn.
exercises.explanation: 独立主格：名词 + 现在分词。

exercises.stem: He sat by the window, ______ in his hand.
exercises.explanation: with 复合结构是独立主格的常见变体。

exercises.stem: 判断：独立主格的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致。
exercises.explanation: 恰恰相反，逻辑主语不一致才使用独立主格。

items.title: 分词作状语与悬垂修饰
items.ruleText:
现在分词表**主动/同时**，过去分词表**被动/完成**。
分词的逻辑主语必须是主句主语，否则构成**悬垂修饰**（dangling modifier），属学术写作硬伤。

examples.en: Written in plain English, the guide reaches a wide audience.
examples.cn: 该指南以浅白英语写成，读者面很广。

examples.en: Having reviewed the data, the author revised two claims.
examples.cn: 查阅数据后，作者修改了两处论断。

exercises.stem: 选出没有悬垂修饰错误的一句：
exercises.explanation: 只有 B 的分词逻辑主语 we 与主句主语一致。

options.text: Walking into the lab, the samples were already prepared.
Walking into the lab, we found the samples prepared.
Walking into the lab, it was noticed the samples were ready.

exercises.stem: ______ by strong evidence, the argument convinced the panel.
exercises.explanation: argument 与 support 是被动关系，用过去分词。

exercises.stem: 判断：分词短语作状语时可以省略逻辑主语，只要读者能猜到即可。
exercises.explanation: 读者“能猜到”不构成语法正确，悬垂修饰在学术写作中会被判为错误。

items.title: 虚拟语气进阶：建议、要求与 should 省略
items.ruleText:
suggest / demand / insist / recommend / propose 等词后的从句用 **(should) + 动词原形**。
形容词结构 It is essential / necessary / vital that … 同理。

examples.en: The board recommended that the report be revised.
examples.cn: 董事会建议修改该报告。

examples.en: It is essential that every student attend the briefing.
examples.cn: 每位学生都必须参加说明会。

exercises.stem: The committee insisted that the deadline ______ extended.
exercises.explanation: insist 表“坚持要求”时从句用 (should) be。

exercises.stem: It is vital that the sample ______ representative.
exercises.explanation: It is vital that + (should) + 动词原形。

exercises.stem: 判断：insist 表示“坚持说（陈述事实）”时，从句用陈述语气而非虚拟语气。
exercises.explanation: He insisted that he was innocent. 此处为陈述事实。

items.title: 语篇衔接：连接副词与指代
items.ruleText:
连接副词（however / therefore / moreover / nevertheless）连接**两个独立句**，
前用句号或分号，后加逗号；不能像 but 那样直接连接两个分句。
代词指代必须唯一明确，避免 this / it 指代模糊。

examples.en: The costs rose sharply; however, demand remained stable.
examples.cn: 成本急剧上升；然而需求保持稳定。

examples.en: Two factors explain this trend. The first is demographic.
examples.cn: 两个因素解释了这一趋势，第一个是人口因素。

exercises.stem: 选出标点正确的一项：
exercises.explanation: however 作连接副词时，前分号后逗号。

options.text: The data were limited, however the conclusion holds.
The data were limited; however, the conclusion holds.
The data were limited however; the conclusion holds.

exercises.stem: ______ , the sample size was small; the findings are therefore tentative.
exercises.explanation: Admittedly 引出让步，与后文的谨慎结论呼应。

exercises.stem: 判断：学术写作中应尽量避免用 this 单独指代前一整句的复杂内容。
exercises.explanation: 应写作 this trend / this finding 等“this + 名词”形式，保证指代明确。
